p2_early_recovery_comparison.early_recovery_hotspot_rule: hotspot if both RMSE and target std exceed the median of the other available buckets

teacher_q_ranking.empirical_action_ranking_reason: C1 stores one realized reward/trajectory per state-action and has no matched same-state counterfactual BC/PPO actions; observed MC return cannot rank alternative actions.

limitations: MC is a single realized return under the frozen BC rollout; rows within an episode and agents are correlated.
The held-out episodes are safe in the current seed stream unless episode reports state otherwise; failure calibration is unavailable when no failures occur.
Teacher-Q ranking is legal only for the current Forward Final C1 contract; it is not a causal empirical action ranking.
No same-state counterfactual BC/PPO actions are stored, so empirical short-horizon/MC ranking of alternative actions is unsupported.
